title: School: Second Period
summary: Scene 6. Their first free period, as the Deputy Director promised: a natural history lesson, or the small-arms range. Each one pays off tonight.
goal: Each player has spent the period where they chose, and Section Nine leaves for the city with the docket.
howToPlay: Warm and quick: the first adults who are glad to see them. Each player picks; cut between the two. Not rolling is always fine.

intro.where: The school block and the Butts, the period after the stores.
intro.readAloud: The timetable has nothing against second period but two words: own choice. Down the corridor, a door is propped open on a room that smells of seawater and preserving jars. Across the yard, a long roofed range is popping with small-arms fire.
intro.landmark: The yard between the school block and the range.

carriesIn.then: Someone has the docket in a pocket, and they're due in the city after this.

position.note: Between the school block and the Butts.

cast.role: Teaches natural history from thirty years of the city's drains and tide-line.

brief.wants: Anyone, at all, to be interested.
brief.opensWith: A jar pressed into the nearest hands: "Hold that. Both hands. It's heavier than it looks."

willDiscuss.topic: What lives in the city's drains
willDiscuss.note: "Centipedes as long as your arm, this time of year. They climb, they nest, and they bite."
She took the label off one eleven years ago, because the label was a guess.

willNotDiscuss.why: She won't guess twice: "I don't know. Somebody will, one day."

voice.register: Fast and delighted. Says the Latin, then the real name. Loves "I don't know".
samples: "Ask me something. Anything. I've four minutes and nobody ever asks me anything."
"That one bites. It won't kill you. It'll ruin a fortnight."

cast.role: Runs the line at the Butts.

brief.wants: Nobody shot, and every round accounted for.
brief.opensWith: "Line is safe. Weapons down, hands off. Who's fired one before? Don't lie to me."

willDiscuss.note: How it pulls, how to clean it, and how to carry it so it never points at anyone.

voice.register: Calm. Loud when it matters, and never twice.

brief.statblock: Proposed: level 3, a range officer, can fight.

beats.text: Each player picks: the natural history lesson, or the range. <trig id="docket-second-period"/>

choicePoint.label: Second period. A lesson, or the range?

options.label: Natural history: a room full of jars.
options.blurb: A lesson on the creatures of the region.
options.consequence: A teacher very glad to see them, and what lives in the drains.

options.label: The range: the Butts.
options.blurb: Fire your new weapon for the first time.
options.consequence: Their new weapon, fired for the first time.

beats.note: If someone picks the gymnasium or the library: A line or two of scene, and a roll on whatever skill fits.

beats.text: The teacher hands round the jars. If anyone engages, offer the check.
beats.note:
Plant: Three jars on the top shelf have no labels.
Secret: Undecided, even to the GM. Nothing in this episode explains them.

beats.text: At the Butts, the range officer runs them through their weapons. If anyone fires, offer the check.
The bell. Thirty seconds to compare, then a pass at the gate and the train into the city.

outro.endsWhen: The bell; they leave with the docket and a pass.

transition.line: The docket says the instrument makers, in the city, back by nineteen hundred.

writeDown: Who went where, and what they rolled.

position.note: Leaving for the gate and the city.

temptations.text: One jar on the top shelf has no label, and the teacher is watching to see who notices.

reactionPrompts.text: Players enjoying a choice of their own.
The two teachers landing as people glad to see them.

notes: D053 promised the afternoons are theirs to choose; this is the first. What each pays tonight: natural history makes the Recall Knowledge on the centipedes in advance; the range gives +1 on a first ranged Strike. A critical failure in either sends a character into tonight's job Fatigued. The telephone exchange and civil defence are still on the timetable for another day.
